title: Google Flow 上了紐約時裝週：兩位設計師各自做了一個工具

sources.title: Google Keyword 官方部落格：Co-creating the future of fashion with Google
Google Labs：Google Flow 官方產品頁
Google 官方部落格 RSS 摘要

verified_facts: 文章標題 Co-creating the future of fashion with Google，頁面日期 Sep 18, 2026，metadata 的 article:published_time 也是 2026-09-18（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）
署名 Yeawon Choi, UX Designer, Envisioning Studio（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

開場：Ask an independent fashion designer how they actually spend their time, and "designing clothes" is rarely the answer. Administrative tasks, factory logistics, and vendor coordination take up the bulk of their days（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

主事單位與時機：Ahead of New York Fashion Week, Google's Envisioning Studio, with support from Google Labs, set out to streamline the creative workflow process（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

做法：Google engineers worked side by side with designers Jane Wade and Sergio Hudson, using Google Flow, our AI creative studio, to build two specialized tools to address their specific challenges（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

Styling Suite 的說明：The Google Flow tool we co-created with Jane, Styling Suite, mapped every facet of her runway model looks.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）
三個工作天：In-person casting and fittings typically consume up to three full days for a design team.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

Styling Suite 能做的事：curate hair, makeup, accessories, shoes, and garments on digital models, then play with the styling virtually. She was able to balance each look and identify missing elements before cutting and sewing additional pieces.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

Runway Visualization 的問題背景：asking his production crew to change lighting and props added to the overall costs, since a new 3D rendering was needed for every design revision（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

Runway Visualization 能做的事：It let him adjust the set-up of his venue and swap the lighting and props with options that worked within his budget. He was also able to refine which paths the models would walk（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

成果只有一句話，沒有數字：The results of these collaborations were visible on the runways at New York Fashion Week — and there's room for more innovation.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

主張：While there's plenty of excitement around AI in the fashion industry, many projects remain stuck in theoretical testing.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

主張下半：AI can make the production process smoother for designers by co-developing tools that work within their existing processes and ensure they're firmly in the driver's seat.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）

結尾：Build your own bespoke tools in Google Flow using natural language to describe the tool or workflow you're looking to create, no coding experience required.（https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/ai/google-flow-fashion-week/）
產品頁標題：Google Flow - AI Creative Studio for Video, Images & Custom Tools（https://labs.google/fx/tools/flow）
RSS 裡有這一篇，標題與連結一致，media:description 是 Jane Wade and Sergio Hudson（https://blog.google/rss/）
unverified_or_excluded: 文章頁面上有一段標明 This content is generated by Google AI. Generative AI is experimental 的摘要與一組條列重點。那是自動生成、官方自己標為實驗性質的內容，本文沒有拿它當任何一項事實的依據，正文與摘要只用人工撰寫的段落。
labs.google 的 Flow 產品頁需要 JavaScript 才會渲染，curl 只拿得到 <title>。因此只引用頁面標題這一項事實，沒有寫任何關於方案、地區、語言或功能細節的說法。
兩位設計師的個人網站（jane-wade.com、sergiohudson.com）在文章裡有連結，但不是本則新聞的一手來源，也沒有他們自己對這次合作的說法；本文沒有引用，也沒有代他們發言。
官方沒有寫兩場秀的日期、省下多少時間或成本、試裝從三天縮短成幾天。文章對成果只有一句「在伸展台上看得見」，本文照原樣寫，沒有補任何數字。
官方沒有寫 Google Flow 的開放地區、方案、語言，也沒有寫做出來的工具能不能分享。本文在正文與 FAQ 裡都寫明這些沒有交代，不推測。
官方沒有寫設計資料（未發表的款式、版型、造型）怎麼保存或使用。本文把這件事列為未交代的部分並建議讀者自行向供應商確認，沒有代任何一方回答。
文中第五段的三人工作室、每季二十套造型是編輯設計的例子，正文已標明不是官方寫的、也不代表實際成效。
editorial_brief: 切角放在「這是一個什麼形狀的做法」，而不是替 Google 宣傳成果：把兩個工具各自解決的環節寫清楚，同時把官方唯一一句沒有數字的成果說明、以及三個完整工作天其實是一般情況而非成果數字這件事，明白分開。最後一節處理一般讀者真正會問的三件事——能不能用、在哪能用、資料安不安全——其中兩件官方沒有寫，就寫明沒有寫。不重寫站上既有的 Google Labs 與 Gemini 相關報導。
